mcp-doctor — diagnose MCP server config conflicts across Cursor's
global (~/.cursor/mcp.json) and per-project (.cursor/mcp.json) configs.

Usage:
  mcp-doctor [options]

Options:
  --path <dir>   Directory to scan for project configs (default: cwd)
  --depth <n>    Max directory depth to descend (default: 4)
  --json         Machine-readable output on stdout (diagnostics stay on stderr)
  --fix          Interactively resolve issues (asks before every write,
                 always creates a .bak backup first)
  -h, --help     Show this help
  -v, --version  Show version

Exit codes: 0 = clean, 1 = issues found, 2 = fatal error.
